subject: Conflicting reinforcement detail for the column baseplate between Foundation Plan S-101

messages.text: The column baseplate reinforcement shown in Foundation Plan S-101 conflicts with additional #5 ties noted in Sheet S-301. We would like this resolved ahead of the next concrete pour. No cost impact is anticipated from this clarification. This is not holding any current pour. We need direction by end of day Wednesday.
Proceed with additional #5 ties per Sheet S-301; Foundation Plan S-101 is superseded. No cost impact is anticipated from this clarification. This is not holding any current pour.
To confirm before we place concrete: does this direction -- additional #5 ties -- apply at every column baseplate on this level, not just the one called out in Foundation Plan S-101?
